title: Cade Cunningham Loves WWE, Hints at Wrestling Future
htmlContent:
In April 2024, Cade Cunningham, an All-Star for the Detroit Pistons, had a thrilling night off when he and former teammate Chimezie Metu caught some prime-time entertainment at WWE Raw. The cameras captured the two enjoying the electric atmosphere, which showed their enthusiasm for professional wrestling. Cunningham talked with LandonBuford.com before the Pistons' game against the Dallas Mavericks at the American Airlines Center after practice Friday afternoon about his potential to enter the squared circle one day.

"Yeah, it is possible for sure. I think WWE is fire," Cunningham said. "I grew up loving WWE. It's cool, you know that, but I would be down to do it for sure."

Cade Cunningham’s WWE Fandom and Potential Crossover

Cunningham's admiration for WWE aligns with the growing trend of NBA players engaging in professional wrestling. Cunningham has the potential to become the latest NBA player to make a WWE appearance, following the likes of Dwight Howard and Trae Young. The 6-foot-6 point guard has the potential to make a smooth transition into the world of wrestling with his size, athleticism, and charisma. WWE and AEW have expressed their desire to bring in high-profile athletes to increase their mainstream appeal, and Cunningham's name recognition could make him a top choice.

NBA Stars and WWE: A Growing Connection

Cunningham isn't the only NBA player who has expressed interest in WWE. Shaquille O'Neal, Karl Malone, and Dennis Rodman have made memorable wrestling appearances for the league over the years. Most recently, Giannis Antetokounmpo and Tyrese Haliburton have also been seen at WWE events, further strengthening the appeal of the NBA-WWE crossover. Cunningham's position as the Pistons' franchise cornerstone may prevent fans from seeing him play in the ring for some time. However, with his passion for WWE and the entertainment industry, a future wrestling cameo or even a full-fledged crossover doesn't seem far-fetched.

Could We See Cunningham in WWE or AEW?

Although he remains committed to leading the Pistons back to relevance, Cunningham's comments indicate that he might eventually consider stepping into the wrestling world. His enthusiasm for the sport is unmistakable, whether it's a unique appearance, a tag-team match, or even a long-term commitment post-basketball. Cade Cunningham's potential as a future superstar in WWE or AEW is something Pistons and wrestling fans can bask in now. Expect to see the Pistons' young star delivering a slam dunk inside the ring as the NBA-WWE crossover trend continues.
